Always 403 `forbidden` with a message: a restore replaces the whole database, so it runs from the command line (`bun scripts/db-restore.ts <id>`), never from the API

post.summary: Queue an announcement for every account in the audience that reads announcements and keep it in the history. It answers at once with `status` queued and 0 recipients; a background job rings the bells in chunks (`sending`, then `sent`) and `recipients` counts those reached so far, so poll `GET /admin/broadcasts` for progress. Only accounts that existed when it was sent are reached. 422 on `cityId` for an unknown city

get.summary: How many accounts an announcement would reach: `roles` (repeat the key), optional `cityId`, `verifiedOnly`. Only accounts that read announcements count

post.summary: Step 1: mail a 6-digit code for one change to the owner's inbox. Body `{ op: create|update|delete, input }` is the change itself; the code fits that change only and lasts 10 minutes. Answers when it was asked (`at`), to send back as `x-confirm-at`. 404 while the endpoint is off. Needs `x-secret-key`
Step 2: create the admin, only while the platform has none. Needs `x-secret-key`, `x-confirm-code` and `x-confirm-at`

patch.summary: Step 2: change the admin's name, email or password; a new email or password signs the admin out everywhere. Needs `x-secret-key`, `x-confirm-code` and `x-confirm-at`

delete.summary: Step 2: delete the admin account; the platform has none until a create. Needs `x-secret-key`, `x-confirm-code` and `x-confirm-at`
